name: Cumin-Lime Arugula Salad with Bacon, Blueberries, Croutons & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 (170 g) pkgs blueberries
3 (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, cut bread into 1-inch cubes.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add bread cubes and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add crispy bacon, croutons, blueberries, arugula, and feta to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
